locationText: The 2017 F-150 owner's manual says the Safety Compliance Certification Label is affixed to the door hinge pillar, door latch post, or the edge of the door near the latch, next to the driver's seating position. The manual source reviewed here does not identify a paint-code field on that label.
sourceTitle: 2017 F-150 Owner's Manual — Vehicle Certification Label
reuseRights: Paraphrased label placement only; paint-field identity not established by this source. Do not reproduce Ford diagrams or manual content without permission.
